sentences.text: 3 . Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is not totally hostile.
Offence committed by applicant is serious in nature.
In these circumstances, he may not be released on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
The material witnesses in the case have already been examined and applicant is in jail since 05.07.2023.
Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
